stem: A six-sided die is suspected of bias. The die is thrown 100 times and it is found that the score is 2 on 20 throws. It is given that the probability of obtaining a score of 2 on any throw is $p$.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find an approximate 94% confidence interval for $p$.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Use your answer to part **(i)** to comment on whether the die may be biased.
